document_citations.page_or_section: Statin Therapy Monitoring / Baseline Liver Function
document_citations.quote_or_value: A baseline liver panel (e.g. ALT) is generally obtained before starting a statin. Routine ongoing liver-enzyme monitoring in an asymptomatic patient is usually not needed; liver enzymes are checked if the patient develops symptoms suggestive of hepatotoxicity (e.g. unexplained fatigue, jaundice, right-upper-quadrant pain) or if clinically indicated for another reason.
